newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CDL buys development site for NZ$5.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: CDL buys development site for NZ$5.5 mln.

text.p: CDL Investments Ltd said on Friday it had bought a 17.6 hectare development site at Sturges Rd in Henderson, Auckland, for NZ$5.5 million.
It said the prime residential site had the potential to be developed into a minimum of 175 residential sections.
The property development company said some sites had excellent views back to the Auckland Harbour Bridge, central city and Rangitoto.
Construction is planned for the 1997/98 summer construction season, with the first sections available in May 1998.
"This acquisition will complement our existing land development activity throughout the country and will strengthen our position in Auckland," CDL said.
The acquisition will be effected through CDL Investments' wholly-owned subsidiary CDL Land NZ Limited.
It will be funded fully by CDL Investments' internal resources and existing bank facilities.
The company said that in terms of value, 49 percent of its portfolio was now in Auckland, 33 percent in the Hamilton Bay of Plenty region and the balance spread across the country.
